pages.text: Dropped from spined dragons (Deadly Nadder, Deathly Galeslash, Hushboggle, Razorwhip, Screaming Death, and Whispering Death). Each spine can be used to craft a Dragon Spine Spear for that type of spine.
pages.title: Basic Information

pages.text: Dropped when using a brush on a Dragon, also obtained by slaying dragons.
